content.comment_body: Hello! Is it possible to use a momentary push button in [product_name]? If not, do you have any recommendations for achieving this function in [product_name] Soft Comfort? Regards//
Which [product_name] version are you using? In the current release, [version_no], there is a push button available.
I'm using that version. So, the push button works as momentary, and the switch button operates as on/off? Is it that simple?
Correct. The push button supports two actions: 1) Clicking creates a pulse signal. 2) Holding keeps the signal high as long as the mouse button is pressed.
